Name: (CP) Vanillaish Alexandra (Genderbend Alex)
Author: Hitme11
Description:
Portraits of your genderbend gymbro, Alex, vanilla-friendly style to play with other portraits mod. Doesn't contain her sprites or change her name in-game. Use in tandem with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes - Bachelors to Bachelorettes[/url].

INSTRUCTION:
- Put [CP] Vanillaish Alex into your mod folder.
﻿- In configuration, choose between two version of Alex: Sweat or NoSweat (or type "Yes", "No" under AlexSweat in the config.json file).

COMPATIBILITY:
﻿- [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes - Bachelors to Bachelorettes[/url]: tested.
﻿- Other mod that change Alex portraits: depends on what mod load first, if you use any mod that have configurations like [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetic[/url] or [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/17059]DSV[/url], I recommend to turn off Alex changes in those mod.

PERMISSIONS: As always, I don't block any of my mod content from modification. Feel free to use any of my content in your mod or upload your modification version on Nexus, credit me if you want. 

CREDITS: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1950]Invatorzen's Dialogue Changes - Bachelors to Bachelorettes[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/7116]Vanilla Facelift (Portrait Mod)[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11491]Nyapu's Portraits[/url] for inspiration.
